messages:
Ana (partnerships): Heads-up: NovaEdge asked for a co-published perf/W bench for the new A100X chassis + Redwood runtime. Goal is a marketplace-ready blurb + 1-page methods note. Key asks: standardized measurement rig, kernel/firmware versions to lock, SI repro steps for field installs, and embargo timing. Draft plan below, please annotate.

Devon (eng-runtime): Proposed model matrix: rw-gpt-lite (open baseline) + rw-35b-shard (throughput target). Configs: seq=2048, batches=1/4/16, kv-cache warm, q8_0 and q4_1 variants. Kernel tuning branch: redwood/tune/a100x-novaedge. Sample QA run:```bash
./bench/run --model rw-gpt-lite --seq 2048 --batch 16 --quant q8_0 --warmup 1200 --out /tmp/bench.json
```I'll push the branch this afternoon.

Ravi (perf): Measurement matrix (short):
- Primary metrics: steady tokens/sec, p50/p95 decode latency, node power (PDU, 1s), tokens/Joule, thermal delta.
- Protocol: 3 repeats, cold startup + warmed (1k tokens) + 20m sustained steady-state.
- Publish threshold: show both best-case and reproducible median. For headline: prefer tokens/J > 4.0 for batch16 on q8_0; otherwise frame as "optimized trade-off".
Also need exact artifact block: git commit, kernel config flags, firmware/bmc versions, docker image sha256.

Linh (NovaEdge): We can run on our 2U A100X rigs. We will capture PDU readings (1s) and our neon-power daemon output. Note: one chassis variant tripped thermal gating at 50m; we'll flag any throttle windows and attach fan/BIOS settings. We'll accept the redwood branch and run within 4 business days after branch is published.

Omar (si-integrator): From SI side: we need reproducible install steps (ansible playbook, bios knobs, driver versions). I can validate on a customer-like rack and report delta vs lab. Suggest adding a "field variance" appendix to the note.

Ana (partnerships): Good call. Maya: for PR/marketplace timing, we want both listings live same day. Can PressOps hold embargo until legal + test artifacts signoff?

Maya (pressops): Yes. Timeline idea: internal review + legal signoff (2 business days after logs uploaded), then Tuesday announce to align with NovaEdge PR. I'll prepare PR skeleton and marketplace copy template; will need headline numbers and reproducibility snippet.

benchbot: Reminder: upload bench artifacts (bench.json, power-traces.csv, docker sha) to s3://redwood-partners/partners/novaedge-a100x/ by 1739005400.

Ravi (perf): Practical notes: disable powercap, record DVFS state, pin IRQs for network (if used), and capture GPU utilization traces. Use median across runs; include raw traces in appendix. I'll assemble the analysis notebook with plotting and summary tables.

Devon (eng-runtime): I'll include a short marketplace blurb draft: supported configs, expected tokens/J ranges, kernel/firmware compatibility, and a "notes" field on thermal/scale caveats. Will post draft here after branch push.

Linh (NovaEdge): Confirm powercap/DVFS control. We'll run 3 repeats and include raw PDU logs and BMC dumps (sanitized).

Ana (partnerships): Action items recap:
- Devon: push redwood/tune/a100x-novaedge + marketplace blurb (due 24h).
- Linh: run matrix and upload artifacts to S3 (due 4bd).
- Ravi: analysis notebook + 1p methodology draft + reproducibility block (due 3bd).
- Omar: validate SI playbook on a rack and produce field variance note (due 6bd).
- Maya: embargo calendar + PR skeleton (due 3bd).
React with :white_check_mark: to accept or :eyes: if you need more time.

Devon (eng-runtime): :white_check_mark: pushing branch now.

Ravi (perf): :eyes: may need one extra day if variance >7%.

Linh (NovaEdge): :white_check_mark: lab run scheduled tomorrow morning (PT).

Omar (si-integrator): :white_check_mark: will start ansible playbook tonight.

Maya (pressops): :white_check_mark: drafting calendar hold and PR skeleton.
